decisions.text: Raw guards, reads and writes stay in Worldline.C_API in original order; value decisions in SPARK; maximal-run rule M1-M4 preserves short-circuit order, intervening transport operations, allocations and early returns, with no prevalidation.
No new Pre and no added functional Post; Global null is an effect boundary only; out formals and results defined on every path; acceptance payloads read only after the discriminant test (A1).
Pending-component Off copies mirror the core files except SPARK_Mode; only an ABI- and scope-preserving component route is admissible (operator item D-13).
Wholesale relocation of the diagnostic state, check-then-act and procedures into C_API is withdrawn.

Diagnostic state (two unchanged Atomic Booleans under an External abstract state with default volatility properties), every transition, control codes, latch, text composition and catenation-overflow handling stay in SPARK Evaluation_Completion_C; C_API keeps only Put_Line/Flush on Standard_Error, their handlers calling the SPARK latch, Exception_Information on transport-held occurrences, and the interleaving. Atomic access order is unchanged (DESIGN §4.6).

v2/v3 transport calls the existing total Well_Formed before any write; Decide_Total wrapper discharges W.Decide's Pre; extra Well_Formed evaluation costed (rel 1 to 2, chk 2 to 3 per accepted call), not called constant-time; D-36 OPEN.
Controls are additive only; PK-0 encodes defined original behaviour only; C-14 proposed behaviour kept separate from baseline.

Value routines re-evaluate the identical SPARK predicate on the identical captured constant and return a dead refusal value; no routine re-checks bounds, lengths or any relation the original did not test.

Finalization uses Decide_No_Rows_Value for Operations 0/1 and Decide_Rows_Value after the fully assigning row loop for Operations 2/3; Captured stays allocated for every operation and is never passed or read on 0/1.
Accept_Context_Fields and Accept_Context_Row are total functions returning variant records whose active variant is fully defined; original test and decode order kept.

Summary index uses Evaluation_Completion.History_Index (already in REQUIRED_PROVED) instead of the bare Selected index; proof from Apply's Post and History_Update_Reference without any bounds fact; mismatched lengths keep their typed History_Invalid outcome.
Raw_Decide_Value re-checks Decide_Header_Valid and Raw_Fields_Valid; the Operation /= 2 gate stays in the transport chain; no branch deleted.
Native, Ordinary and Finalized locals initialized with complete fixed aggregates before nested calls; native delta costed in A-COST §C16.

Whole-closure checks G1-G8 and K1-K4, profile checks P1-P3, ordered-subsequence token checks O1-O7 with exact counts, diagnostic confinement D1-D5, exactly four recorded predecessor edits E1-E4 with PP2 reconstruction, identity layers I1-I7 with new component pin keys (169 to 176) and raw-bytes binding of Python controls via source inventories.
